$description: Rival Monday design tokens v1 (adopted 2026-10-23 — owner mandate). Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) — every leaf has $value and $type; $extensions.rm.source is one of brand (decided in docs/brand/brand.md or CLAUDE.md), existing (already in packages/ui/src/styles.css), new (proposed by this research), reference (dataviz skill reference palette). No value here is sampled from a screenshot; research estimates live in docs/design-system/research/. Token paths map to CSS variables by replacing dots with dashes: color.background.app -> --color-background-app.

app.$description: App frame behind the content sheet: top bar + sidebar region.

sidebar.$description: Sidebar = part of the frame, same as app. Separation from content comes from the white sheet and its border, not from a second grey.

surfaceSubtle.$description: Band inside the white sheet: table header row in a frame, KPI band, sticky save bar, mobile section separators.

muted.$description: Grey panels with dark text: brief callouts, user chat bubble, nested reply block, segmented-control track, neutral badge.

interactive.$description: Hover fill for rows, nav items, menu items, ghost buttons.

selected.$description: Selected nav item, selected row, applied filter chip.

primary.$description: Body, headings, KPI values. 15.5:1 on surface.

secondary.$description: Secondary body, table cells of lesser weight. 10.4:1.

muted.$description: Descriptions, helper text, metadata, table headers. 5.2:1 on canvas, 4.8:1 on muted. Replaces #64748B (4.23:1 on #EEF2F6 fails AA).

link.$description: Links and text buttons. 5.4:1 on surface.

onPrimary.$description: Label on action.primary: ink, 5.93:1 (OD-1 resolved 2026-10-23; replaces white at 2.62:1). For agency primaries, computed: white or ink, whichever contrasts more.

accent.$description: Amber used as small text on white. 5.0:1.

success.$description: Positive delta and success badge text. 7.1:1 on white, 6.4:1 on successSurface.

default.$description: Frames, dividers, sheet edge, section rules.

subtle.$description: Row dividers inside tables and lists; chart gridlines.

control.$description: Outline of secondary buttons, segmented control, filter chips (their label identifies them).

strong.$description: Boundary of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios — the boundary is what identifies the control, so it needs 3:1 (3.01:1 on white; WCAG 1.4.11).

secondary.$description: Secondary (outline) button fill; border = border.control, text = text.primary.

danger.$description: Destructive fill inside a confirmation dialog only. White text 4.83:1.

success.$description: Icons, dots, chart deltas (graphics only; 3.3:1). Text uses text.success.

warning.$description: Warning icon and alert left bar. Deliberately darker and more orange than brand accent #F5A524 so a warning never reads as Friday/priority.

warningSurface.$description: Paler than chip-warning #FEF3C7 and never solid; text = text.warning (6.65:1).

ring.$description: 2px ring + 2px surface offset. 5.5:1 on white. Replaces --ring: var(--primary) (2.62:1 fails WCAG 2.4.13/1.4.11).

accent.$description: Wordmark 'monday', Friday pill, high-priority marker, star ratings. Never a warning, never a series colour.

you.$description: The viewer's own business. Validated set with rival1/rival2: dataviz validate_palette --pairs all, light: PASS (worst CVD ΔE 9.0, normal-vision 18.1, all ≥3:1).

rival2.$description: Second highlighted rival. A third highlight is not allowed — violet and magenta candidates failed the validator.

context.$description: All other rivals / peer lines. 2.18:1 — relief rule: legend + table view required.

peerBand.$description: Market range band behind the 'you' line.

display.$description: Welcome / brief hero only; max one per page.

bodyReading.$description: Briefs and Friday answers; owners read these on phones.

bodySmall.$description: Table cells, nav items, menu items, dense lists.

label.$description: Form labels, filter chips, tabs, badges.

caption.$description: Helper text, metadata, timestamps, table headers (with medium weight). Smallest text size in the system.

groupLabel.$description: Sidebar group labels, menu section labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

inline.$description: Gap between related inline items: icon-label, button-button.

stack.$description: Gap between related stacked items: fields in a form.

fieldInternal.$description: Label to input; input to helper text.

sheetGutter.$description: Gap between the content sheet and the window edge (right, bottom) on ≥1024px.

buttonX.$description: Horizontal button padding (md); sm buttons use space.2_5.

frameBody.$description: Padding inside a frame or card.

controlSm.$description: Toolbar / table / popover-footer buttons and chips.

controlLg.$description: Touch (<768px) controls; WCAG 2.5.8 target ≥24px is met at every size, 44px is the comfort target.

settingsNavWidth.$description: Drill-in settings nav replaces the main nav in the same column.

md.$description: Below: bottom tab bar, no sidebar, full-bleed sections.

lg.$description: Below: sidebar collapses to off-canvas drawer; sheet loses its gutter and radius.

xl.$description: Friday docked panel may push content only at ≥1280; below it overlays as a sheet.

xs.$description: Status badges, tags, citation pills, checkbox, tooltip, count badge, business avatar.

sm.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, menu items, segmented thumb, alerts.

md.$description: Content sheet, frames, cards, popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts, composer. DEFAULT container radius.

lg.$description: User chat bubble, mobile bottom-sheet top corners.

full.$description: Filter chips, Friday pill, switches, person avatars, status dots, segmented track.

emphasis.$description: Active tab underline, selected tile, focus ring.

none.$description: Every static surface: sheet, sections, frames, cards, tables.

overlay.$description: Popover, menu, select list, tooltip, toast, bulk-action bar, command palette.

dialog.$description: Dialog and mobile bottom sheet (always with scrim).

sticky.$description: Sticky table header, sticky save bar.

panel.$description: Friday docked panel and peek panel when overlaying (<1280px).
